Winch.start: bash -c 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=2 && cd ~/ros2_ws/src/paint_base/paint_base/winch/python/ && python3 winch_node.py --nosensor --port /dev/ttyUSB0'

Teensy.start: bash -c 'source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source ~/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=2 && cd ~/ros2_ws/src/paint_end_effector/paint_end_effector/ && python3 teensy_node.py'

Lidar.start: bash -c 'source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source ~/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=2 && ros2 launch unitree_lidar_ros2 launch.py'
